title: Koebe circle-domain uniformization conjecture
exact_target: Is every domain on the Riemann sphere conformally equivalent to one whose complementary components are round disks or points, even with arbitrary connectivity?

sources.citation: Zheng-Xu He and Oded Schramm, Fixed Points, Koebe Uniformization and Circle Packings, Annals of Mathematics137(1993),369-406; with Ntalampekos2026 survey.
